limits: Parity is claimed only on CPU in float32 against diffusers 0.40.0 and transformers 5.18.0.
MPS and CUDA runs are smoke tests (finite output, shape, CPU difference recorded); no parity claim.
No safety checker or invisible watermark; the reference ran with safety_checker=None.

Only the checkpoint scheduler is implemented: PNDM (PLMS) for SD 1.x, DDIM for SD 2.1, Euler with trailing spacing for SD-Turbo, LCM for LCM Dreamshaper v7, Hyper-SDXL and DMD2, Euler for SDXL, flow-match Euler for Z-Image and SD 3.5, flow-match Euler with a static shift for FLUX.1 schnell and Lumina-Image 2.0, and dynamic shifting for FLUX.1 dev, Qwen-Image 2.1 and LongCat-Image, flow-match Euler with exponential shifting for Krea 2 and linear shifting for CogView4, DDPM for HunyuanDiT, UnCLIP and DDPM for Kandinsky 2.2, DDPM Wuerstchen for Stable Cascade, and DPM-Solver++ for PixArt and Sana (flow sigmas).
Text-to-image only; SD 1.x img2img is not implemented.
